description: This Dart file defines the 'DiscoverScreen' widget for a Flutter app, which enables users to search for books from a backend and add them to their library. It incorporates UI components like a search bar, loading indicators, and a list of search results with option to add books.

classes.name: DiscoverScreen
classes.description: Public widget class representing the discover/search screen in the app.

classes.name: _DiscoverScreenState
classes.description: Private state class managing the state and UI of the DiscoverScreen widget.

methods.name: _onSearch
methods.description: Handles the search input; trims query and triggers search in provider if query is not empty.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes the text controller when the widget is disposed to free resources.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget UI, including a search bar, loading indicator, no results message, and list of search results with add buttons.
